why: The fixed subset of every Code plan gate after P0 (ADR-0122). Ten SWE instances across seven repositories, half under fifteen minutes and half between fifteen minutes and an hour, all with tests that run in seconds; five terminal tasks (build, shell, git, Python, SQL); five Sub Rosa tasks (four TypeScript, one Rust). Chosen for speed and spread before any score existed; replaced only by an addendum to ADR-0122 once full passes show which tasks never discriminate.
